summary.text: Robert G. Ortt is a Republican state senator from New York who has represented District 62 since January 2015 and serves as Senate Minority Leader; he is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Robert Ortt worked as a financial analyst and served as mayor, city treasurer and city clerk of North Tonawanda, in western New York.
He served in the New York Army National Guard, is a veteran of Operation Enduring Freedom, and received a Bronze Star for his service.
Ortt assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2015, succeeding George Maziarz, and was elected Senate Minority Leader in June 2020.
Ballotpedia lists him as ranking member of the Rules Committee.
In the 2026 general election he faces Democrat Thomas Arida, who is running on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
